prerequisites: For the course "2.0/1.5 VU Betriebliche Kostenrechnung", successful completion of the StEOP (Study Entrance and Orientation Phase) is required.

learning_outcomes.text: Describe the complex functioning of companies.
Define diverse design and management concepts.
Represent the company as a sociotechnical system.
Examine operational resource flows and associated instruments.
Explain instruments of production and quality management.
Fundamentally apply instruments of production and quality management.
Apply project management tools for planning, implementation, and controlling.
Calculate basic operational cost accounting calculations and analyze company-relevant issues from an economic and business administration perspective.
Work on practical problems in a project context.
Systematically investigate complex practical questions and design tasks.
Present work results appropriately for the audience.
Solve tasks independently and self-organized, both individually and in a team.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of Business and Corporate Management: Strategic Management
Fundamentals of Business and Corporate Management: Organization
Fundamentals of Business and Corporate Management: Value creation in production companies
Fundamentals of Business and Corporate Management: Assistance systems

Fundamentals of Business and Corporate Management: Human resource management
Fundamentals of Business and Corporate Management: Leadership
Fundamentals of Business and Corporate Management: Annual financial statements
Fundamentals of Business and Corporate Management: Cost accounting
Fundamentals of Business and Corporate Management: Sustainability accounting
Fundamentals of Business and Corporate Management: Innovation management
Fundamentals of Business and Corporate Management: Change management and corporate culture
Production and Quality Management 1: Forms of production organization
Production and Quality Management 1: Production planning and control
Production and Quality Management 1: Quality assurance and management
Production and Quality Management 1: QM systems
Operational Cost Accounting: Fundamentals of production and cost theory
Operational Cost Accounting: Process-oriented production functions and cost functions (construction and calibration)
Operational Cost Accounting: Process cost accounting (activity analysis, model calibration and calculation)

Project Management: Methods of project management (e.g., environmental analysis, project planning methods, resource planning, cost planning, project implementation, project controlling)
assessment_rules: Lectures are assessed by written exams. The lecture-exercise (Vorlesungsübung) is assessed by written tests and by homework/protocols. The specific teaching and learning forms and examination modalities for each course unit are to be announced in the information system before the start of the semester.
